{{Quote|The losses of greenies Vere and Ince during the JanFathal mission...|Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano recalling the JanFathal mission|<ref name="stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Vere''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who underwent [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[flash training]] and served in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he participated in the [[Battle of JanFathal]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and helped to rescue [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Hallena Devis]]. During the mission, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]].<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Personality and traits==
As a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Vaize stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vere first appeared in the [[2009]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="No Prisoners" />
